name: a new file from the defaults, then patches that add, merge and delete keys
a new file takes the app-wide layout and auto-advance
an empty app-wide layout falls back to qwerty
an app-wide auto-advance that is not a boolean makes the new file invalid
an existing file is rewritten with its known fields in their order
a file without layer names reads and writes them as empty
patches that make the settings invalid are refused
files that are not valid settings read as none and are replaced by the next patch
uids that are not one path segment
patches of one keyboard made together all apply, in call order
the typing test results of every keyboard, with their names
a null entry in the keyboard names fails the pool
